purpose: Diagnose whether positive abundance transitions in the already-frozen MAPPPD regional panels are realized primarily as gains at sites occupied in the previous complete season or as gains from exact zero to positive at previously empty retained sites.

source.inherited_observation_calibration: frozen Paper 2 image/direct and accuracy calibration
source.eligible_panel_roster: exact seven species x APBP-region networks from MAPPPD_REGIONAL_CONCENTRATION_RECEIPT_V2

transition_definition.included: consecutive retained complete-season pairs within each frozen panel for which adjusted panel total increases
transition_definition.gross_existing_gain: sum site_gain over sites occupied at t
transition_definition.gross_expansion_gain: sum site_gain over sites empty at t and positive at t+1

required_outputs: number with at least one exact-zero retained site at t
number with at least one zero-to-positive transition
forbidden: new occupancy threshold other than exact adjusted zero
changing retained rosters or complete seasons
calling the diagnostic a confirmatory test of social attraction
using the result to alter the already-closed MAPPPD concentration inference

interpretation.if_existing_dominates: Generates the prospective intensification-before-expansion hypothesis for an independent dataset.
interpretation.if_zero_to_positive_dominates: Do not pursue an intensification-first hypothesis as the main independent test.
interpretation.if_exact_zeros_are_too_rare: The MAPPPD regional panel is not informative about colonization; do not invent a low-count threshold.

stop_rule: One descriptive execution only. No threshold, null, lag, site subset or alternative definition may be added after output inspection.
